mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM account_global_role agr JOIN role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = agr.role_id JOIN app_permission p ON p.permission_id = rp.permission_id WHERE agr.account_id = #{accountId}
SELECT community_id FROM account_community_scope WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY community_id

SELECT b.community_id FROM property_unit pu JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE pu.property_unit_id = #{propertyUnitId}

SELECT b.community_id FROM bill bi JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = bi.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE bi.bill_id = #{billId}

SELECT b.community_id FROM residence r JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = r.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE r.residence_id = #{residenceId}
SELECT community_id FROM building WHERE building_id = #{buildingId}

SELECT b.community_id FROM residence r JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = r.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE r.person_id = #{personId} AND r.end_date IS NULL ORDER BY r.start_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT community_id,community_name FROM community WHERE status='ACTIVE' AND community_id IN #{id} AND 1=0 ORDER BY community_id
